hook: The 90 second corridor check before you view any unit
items: Neighbour's door open, smoke smell<small>Tells you how they treat shared space</small>
Shoes and items spilling into the corridor<small>Space disputes tend to follow</small>
Ball or tyre marks on the walls<small>Expect a livelier, noisier floor</small>
take: The unit is only half the decision. The neighbours are the other half.
